name: Uchiha Itachi (S)
description: Uchiha Itachi is a member of Akatsuki, and the brother of Uchiha Sasuke. He has mastered the sharingan completely.

skills.name: Amaterasu Field
skills.description: Itachi creates a field around his team using Amaterasu. For 1 turn, any enemy that uses a new skill on Itachi or his allies will be dealt 5 affliction damage permanently*. This skill is invisible and is replaced by 'Mangekyou Overexertion' for 1 turn.

skills.name: Crow Genjutsu
skills.description: Itachi places a genjutsu on one enemy. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill they will be countered. If successful, the countered enemy's skills will cost 1 additional random chakra until they use a new skill. This skill is invisible and is replaced by 'Mangekyou Overexertion' for 1 turn.

skills.name: Mastered Mangekyou Sharingan
skills.description: Itachi uses his mastered Mangekyou Sharingan to deceive an enemy. For 1 turn, the first new skill used by that enemy will be reflected to a random different enemy. This skill is invisible,  ignores invulnerability and is replaced by 'Mangekyou Overexertion' for 1 turn.

skills.name: Clone Genjutsu
skills.description: This skill makes Uchiha Itachi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Mangekyou Overexertion
skills.description: By pushing his Mangekyou Sharingan beyond its natural limits, Itachi deals 20 damage to one enemy. If this skill is available through: 'Amaterasu Field', the enemy will take 5 additional damage from 'Amaterasu Field' permanently; 'Crow Genjutsu', Itachi is healed for 15 health; 'Mastered Mangekyou Sharingan', Itachi removes all harmful skills from himself.
